issue.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR)
issue.issueBackground: The application fails to enforce object-level authorization checks when accessing user profiles via numeric ID parameters.
issue.remediationBackground: Implement proper access control checks validating that the authenticated user owns the requested object ID.
issue.issueDetail: By modifying the user ID parameter from 1024 to 1025, the application returns sensitive PII records of another tenant user without authentication errors.
issue.remediationDetail: Enforce server-side authorization checks on all REST endpoints.

issue.name: SQL Injection in Search Query Parameter
issue.issueBackground: Parameter 'q' is concatenated directly into SQL queries without sanitization.
issue.remediationBackground: Use parameterized SQL queries (prepared statements) for all database operations.
issue.issueDetail: Database error 'syntax error near OR 1=1' was returned, and arbitrary database extraction was demonstrated.
